name: Vaeshok's Cave (surface shrine)
title: Vaeshok's Cave
summary: Vaeshok's Cave on Dark Isle holds Sclavus Acolytes of T'thuun and the Ruschk Vaeshok; the cave itself is a dungeon. At the map point the kit shows its surface shrine on an obsidian hilltop (z 104): the same mossy round spire structure (0x01003D10, 18.4 m) with the red-purple Black Spear Ice Totem (7.9 m) inside, two skeleton figures on spear pedestals and golden scraps around it, Black Coral and coral golems on the slopes. Only the exterior is filmed.
